scholarships.name: Institutions of Higher Education in Hesse: Doctoral Scholarships
scholarships.description: Specific higher education institutions of the state of Hesse award doctoral scholarships to particularly qualified junior scholars and researchers who wish to conduct doctoral research at a Hessian higher education institution. Applications must be submitted directly to the selected higher education institutions, which will also provide detailed information on the application procedure.
scholarships.sourceQuote: particularly qualified young academics with a doctoral project at a higher education institution in Hesse

eligibility.sourceQuote: admission to a doctoral programme at a higher education institution in Hesse
